name: obsidian-code-graph
description: Code Graph — visualize code relationships as an interactive graph inside Obsidian.

scripts.dev: node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs && node scripts/embed-wasm.mjs && node esbuild.config.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs && node scripts/embed-wasm.mjs && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
